name: Install Python deps via uv (bare Ubuntu)
recipe_commands: source $HOME/.local/bin/env && cd /app && uv init && uv add pandas pyarrow
cd /app && uv run -- python3 -c "import pandas as pd; df = pd.read_csv('/app/data.csv'); df.to_parquet('/app/data.parquet', index=False); print('OK', len(df))"
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/0.7.13/install.sh | sh && source $HOME/.local/bin/env && cd /app && uv init --no-workspace 2>/dev/null; cd /app && uv add pandas pyarrow
